Info

Defines PneumaticState enumeration for pneumatic pump and blow-off valve actuation.

class scaralang.core.model.dsl.ast.pneumatic_state.PneumaticState(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]¶

Bases: StrEnum

Enumeration of discrete states for pneumatic actuators.

It defines:

attributes:
ON - Actuator energized (pump pulling vacuum or valve blowing).
OFF - Actuator de-energized.
OFF = 'OFF'¶
ON = 'ON'¶
